need_coverage.gap: Prototype window is covered only by UCI 360 (research-only licence conflict, -200 sentinels, one unnamed road-level device); production window depends on the internal station feed, which is access-restricted and missing VR-03 after 2024-06-30.

overall_rationale: All three must needs (N1, N2, N3) are met only with conditions: N1 prototype via UCI 360 and production via the internal station feed; N2 via the internal traffic counts; N3 via Open-Meteo. None of the must needs is unmet. The key conditions are access approvals for the internal sources, the Open-Meteo non-commercial licence decision for production, the UCI research-only licence conflict and -200 recoding, the traffic method break, and the missing station/counter keys. The Chicago link is not feasible (unreachable, unknown licence, wrong geography), and N5 is unmet under the clinic data policy. The should need N4 and could needs N6 are conditional or partial and do not drive the overall verdict.
